```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, rgeoda, tidyverse)
```

```{r}
shan_sf <- read_rds("data/rds/shan_sf.rds")
```

```{r}
queen_w <- queen_weights(shan_sf)
summary(queen_w)
```

```{r}
shan_data <- shan_sf |>
  select(16:20) |>
  st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r}
schc_clusters <- schc(k=5, 
                      w=queen_w, 
                      df=shan_data, 
                      method="ward")
```

```{r}
skater_clusters <- skater(k=6, 
                        w=queen_w, 
                        df=shan_data,
                        cpu_threads = 1)
```

```{r}
redcap_clusters <- redcap(k=6, 
                          w=queen_w, 
                          df=shan_data,
                          method="firstorder-singlelinkage")
```

```{r}
clusters <- as.data.frame(schc_clusters$Clusters)
```

```{r}
shan_sf <- shan_sf |>
  cbind(clusters)
```
